performance.verdict: Efficiency is real but spend collapse risks August volume scoreboard.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — leads arriving but attribution is blind.
OVERDUE: Renewal closed 2026-07-23 at $2,200 — August is a prove-it month with no milestone tracking visible yet for leads-to-patients conversion.

CPL efficiency is real: CPL fell 47.33% this 7d on only $26.26/day spend — but 3-day lead signal (Aug 21–23: 5+0+6=11) vs prior 3 days (Aug 18–20: 4+0+3=7) shows fragile volume at collapsed spend; two zero-lead days in the last 6.
Spend has fallen continuously from ~$78/day (Jul 27) to $12–36/day (Aug 22–23) — a 54% drop. With August as prove-it month, this pace may strand the lead-volume target before month end.
GHL shows 91 opportunities created vs 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — 122 leads arriving but pipeline conversion is invisible; likely an intake/tagging gap, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Escalate phone-match attribution gap and contact cleanup as blockers — both overdue; August scoreboard is blind without them.
suggestions.monday_update: Two SOW milestones are overdue: phone-match attribution (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14). Without these, the leads-to-patients scoreboard the client tracks cannot be verified. Success check: both items marked complete and confirmed with Lily sync by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget by ~20% (from ~$26/day toward ~$32/day) to defend August lead volume while CPL floor holds.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend has collapsed from $78/day to $26/day while CPL dropped 47.33% — efficiency is confirmed but volume is at risk in a prove-it month. Raise the Meta daily budget approximately 20% to ~$32/day on the BWS Retargeting campaign. Success check: leads/day return to 5+ average over the next 3 days (by 2026-08-27) without CPL rising above the 28-day baseline of $11.25.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 91 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — flag intake process to Lily sync as a lead-loss point, not an ads issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 91 opportunities created in 28 days with 0 won and 0 appointments recorded — this means leads are arriving from Meta but disappearing before scheduling. Raise with Lily at the next biweekly sync to confirm whether appointments are being booked in OpenDental but not reflected in GHL. Success check: at least a sample of booked appointments visible in GHL or the gap formally documented by 2026-08-28.
